description: Homebrew tap for Gryt Chat. Updated by publish-homebrew.yml in Gryt-chat/gryt on every release.
name: homebrew-tap

description: The Gryt monorepo. Self-hosted voice, video and text chat over WebRTC: desktop and web client, signalling server, Go SFU, auth, and the ops to deploy them. Every component is a submodule with its own repo.
name: gryt

description: Gryt's desktop and web client. React, Vite and Electron. Voice, camera and screen share, with noise suppression and voice activity detection running locally, and a bundled server so you can host from the app itself.
name: client

description: Source for gryt.chat, including the blog and changelog. React and Vite.
name: site

description: Gryt's signalling server. Rooms, presence, invites, uploads and message history on SQLite, over Socket.IO. Decides who may join a server and on what terms.
name: server

description: Gryt's media server, written in Go on Pion. Relays voice, camera and screen share between participants without transcoding, and serves every Gryt server on a host from one process.
name: sfu

description: Gryt's voice engine: signalling, ICE, tracks and audio, with web and React Native adapters.
name: voice

description: Gryt's React component library, built with Tailwind. Published as @gryt/ui and documented at ui.gryt.chat.
name: ui

description: The Keycloak stack behind Gryt accounts, with its themes, proxy config and backup tooling. An account is optional in Gryt, so this is for people who want one identity across servers.
name: auth

description: Source for docs.gryt.chat, built with Next.js and Fumadocs. Covers deploying, configuring and running a Gryt server.
name: docs

description: Write Gryt bots in TypeScript: identity, the join handshake, a typed event stream and a command router.
name: bot

description: Gryt's shared application logic: one implementation of the things the desktop and mobile apps both do.
name: core

description: Gryt's inbox for bug reports and feedback sent from inside the apps. One endpoint, SQLite storage, rate limits, and an AI triage pass.
name: reports

description: Message encryption for Gryt: key derivation, bindings, sealed envelopes, and pinning. Shared by the desktop client and the mobile app.
name: crypto

description: Interactive terminal manager for self-hosted Gryt Chat servers
name: cli

description: Compresses uploads to AVIF and builds thumbnails for a Gryt server. Runs as its own process so a malformed image cannot take down the one holding the keys and the sockets.
name: image-worker

description: The Gryt client for phones. React Native on Expo, iOS and Android.
name: mobile

description: Gryt's operations console — post status announcements that reach status.gryt.chat and every signed-in client.
name: console

description: Gryt's colour theme for Visual Studio Code.
name: code-theme

description: Logos, icons and press material for Gryt.
name: gryt-assets

description: Repository that contains all our discussions data
name: gryt-forum
